minutes.headline: Parks Commission agreed feedback on the Marshall Park schematic design for Walla, keeping a t-ball home in the plan.
minutes.summary: The commission read through a numbered list of design comments from a member with construction expertise on the schematic design by the designer (Walla). It discussed t-ball, outfield size, storage, gates, power, water, parking and lighting. Feedback will be compiled and sent to Walla, and the police chief's input on cameras and lighting will come separately. The only vote was adjournment.

votes.outcome: passed; roll call yes from all five members

budget_items.what_was_said: A commenter noted the town is spending a large sum to build the field and wants it done well.
A member said a minimum number of parking spots is needed to qualify for a grant application.
Members said turf may save mowing costs but needs a funding source for replacement later.
The chair wants cost estimates in the next phase for lighting paths and parking for events.

decisions.decision: Chair will send Walla the outfield comment: accommodate all current users without compromising other park features, and research comparable area high school fields.
Commission on record that the t-ball field will not be removed without an interim and long-term plan; it will sit down with the leagues.
Chair to ask softball and little league coaches whether they prefer attached storage; storage should match across fields.
Feedback to Walla to include a second exit-only point from the overflow parking.
Chair will compile notes, split by this phase and next, and send to Walla; Karen will get the police chief's input on cameras, lighting and call boxes and copy everyone.
Next meeting targeted for the 28th, to review Walla's final schematic report.

The commission put on record that the t-ball field will not be removed without an interim and a long-term plan, and that it will sit down with the leagues.
The chair will send Walla a comment that the outfield should accommodate all current users and that comparable area high school fields be researched.
Feedback to Walla will include a second exit-only point from the overflow parking, and the chair will ask coaches whether they prefer attached storage.
The chair will compile notes split by this phase and next; the police chief's input on cameras, lighting and call boxes will come separately. The only vote was adjournment.

Turf replacement and lighting costs were raised without a funding source or estimate, so they could return as future budget requests or capital items.
